rules.description: Required fields are present and non-null
Enumerated fields hold an allowed value
Business IDs and references follow the documented format
Business IDs are unique within their collection
Every reference points to an existing record of the right type
Hubs have no parent; every other facility feeds an existing hub
Route legs chain through its stops and distances/planned minutes reconcile
Window start < end, issued <= ingested, advisory type consistent with timing
Observation time <= ingestion time <= snapshot and wait >= facility baseline
Planned/current routes connect the shipment origin and destination
Promised delivery and planned pickup match the service-level rules
createdAt <= pickedUpAt <= deliveredAt <= snapshot and createdAt < promisedDeliveryAt
Recorded status and deliveredAt equal the state derived from tracking events
pickedUpAt, statusUpdatedAt and route change fields agree with events
Undelivered shipments have not been silent for longer than max(120h, 2x planned route time + 24h)
Leg sequence numbers are 1..n without gaps
Active legs match their route leg and chain origin -> destination
start <= departure <= arrival and each leg starts when the previous one arrived
actual dwell + transit = planned dwell + transit + queue + weather + carrier
Event facility lies on the shipment planned/current path
Events visit route stops in non-decreasing route order; pickup at origin, delivery at destination
ingestedAt >= occurredAt
Ingestion lag <= 6h (late-arriving event policy threshold)
Events do not occur before the shipment was created
No event occurs or is ingested after the dataset snapshot time
No two events share type, facility and occurrence time
Each event is a legal transition of the shipment state machine
Every input of an ETA snapshot was available at its prediction time
Recomputing the snapshot from stored eligible inputs reproduces it exactly
createdAt <= predictionAt <= snapshot and estimatedArrivalAt >= predictionAt
Adjustment components sum to the total remaining minutes
Evaluation metrics equal estimate minus ground-truth delivery
Every scheduled prediction time has a preserved snapshot
Ground-truth label equals the documented classification rules applied to source records
Every shipment has ground truth and observed deliveries match it
Delay attributions match the attribution rules; exactly one primary reason per delayed shipment
Baseline record counts equal the configured targets
Exported row counts equal source collection counts
Every labelled anomaly is detected by all of its expected rules
